deep_review.conclusion: The instruction contracts separate human specification/agent-ready authorization from builder mutations and review evidence. Builder requires a clean tree and warns its issue assignment is not an atomic same-user lock. Reviewer checks current required CI and rechecks head before posting; neither role merges or enables auto-merge. Linear TEAM/labels and host credentials require configuration. Catalog review establishes the workflow and limits; it did not invoke the skills, issue trackers, Git writes or PR comments.
